title: Lite delivery sky quality split

scope.artChange: Kept canonical desktop sky URLs unchanged while making vercel-lite select the mobile 4K/2K sky layers and suppress the desktop quality upgrade.

limitations: This is a Lite cold-load baseline at one desktop viewport; sustained FPS, GPU/memory lifecycle, and public CDN qualification remain open.
Canonical standalone/local-shadow desktop art identity remains 8K; Beta remains open at 12/24 runtime-cleared hero stars and 12/24 rights-cleared nebulae.
